item.title: Nivlet 2.1.0 · Build 67
item.description: # Nivlet 2.1.0 · Build 67 macOS 13.0+ · Apple Silicon (arm64) only · Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. ## 简体中文 新增截图和系统翻译两个功能页，并整体提升了速度和内存占用。两个功能默认关闭，在设置中打开后才会运行。 **截图** - 按快捷键（默认 F1，可改）冻结屏幕后框选区域，可自动吸附窗口，带放大镜和取色。 - 标注：矩形、箭头、画笔、文字、马赛克；可复制、保存，或钉在桌面上。复制的截图会进入 Nivlet 剪贴板历史，并标为“截图”。 - 识别文字（OCR）和二维码，均在本机完成；结果可直接复制。 - 剪贴板历史中的图片也可以钉在桌面上。 - 需要“屏幕录制”权限，在通用设置的权限区统一查看和授权，并标明哪些功能会用到。 **系统翻译（需要 macOS 15 或更高版本）** - 只使用 macOS 自带的翻译，在本机完成，不连网络服务。 - 选词翻译：选中文字后双击修饰键；截图翻译：双击另一个修饰键后框选。左右两侧的 ⌃、⌥、⌘ 可以分别设置。 - 默认自动判断方向：中文译成英文，其他语言译成简体中文，并记住你上次选的方向。 - 翻译卡片可以复制结果，或替换原来选中的文字。 **速度与内存** - 启动时不再解码全部历史图片：有大截图时，启动内存峰值从约 2.4 GB 降到约 120 MB，复制 5K 截图时从 2.8 GB 以上降到约 140 MB。 - 剪贴板历史中的图片改用保存的小预览图，⌘⇧V 菜单首次打开从约 0.8 秒降到约 0.05 秒，再次打开不到 1 毫秒。 - 打开设置窗口从约 2.3 秒降到约 0.7 秒；设置页每次回传的数据减少约 40%，短时间内的多次刷新合并为一次。 - 锁屏或睡眠时暂停网速采样。 截图、识别和翻译界面都适配了浅色、深色和四种界面语言。新增的设置项写入现有配置文件，原有设置不受影响。 ## English This release adds Screenshot and System Translation pages and makes Nivlet faster and lighter. Both features are off by default and run only after you turn them on in Settings. **Screenshot** - Press a shortcut (F1 by default, configurable) to freeze the screen and select an area, with window snapping, a magnifier and a color picker. - Annotate with rectangles, arrows, pen, text and mosaic; copy, save, or pin the result to the desktop. Copied screenshots appear in Nivlet's clipboard history, marked as screenshots. - Recognize text (OCR) and QR codes on device, and copy the result. - Images in clipboard history can also be pinned to the desktop. - Requires Screen Recording permission, shown and requested in the permissions area of General settings together with the features that use it. **System Translation (macOS 15 or later)** - Uses only macOS's built-in on-device translation; no online service. - Selection translation: select text and double-tap a modifier key. Screenshot translation: double-tap another modifier key and select an area. Left and right ⌃, ⌥ and ⌘ can be set separately. - Direction is automatic by default (Chinese to English, other languages to Simplified Chinese) and remembers your last choice. - The translation card can copy the result or replace the selected text. **Speed and memory** - Startup no longer decodes every history image: with large screenshots in history, peak memory at launch drops from about 2.4 GB to about 120 MB, and copying a 5K screenshot from over 2.8 GB to about 140 MB. - Clipboard history images use small saved previews. The first ⌘⇧V menu opens in about 0.05 s instead of 0.8 s, and later ones in under 1 ms. - The settings window opens in about 0.7 s instead of 2.3 s; each settings refresh sends about 40% less data, and refreshes that arrive together are merged. - Network speed sampling pauses while the screen is locked or asleep. Screenshot, recognition and translation windows follow light and dark mode and all four interface languages. New settings are added to the existing configuration file; existing settings are unchanged. ## Downloads / 下载 Choose either the DMG or ZIP. Both contain the same signed, stapled Build 67 app. Use the `.sha256` attachment to verify downloads. Version 1.0.8 / Build 55 remains the final Intel release; historical assets are retained. ## Verification / 验证 All Lua regression files, command-line JavaScript and Python checks, the privacy scan and the runtime patch check passed locally and in CI. The settings UI suites passed in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English and Japanese, light and dark, at 980 and 620 points wide. Signed test builds of the same changes ran in place of 2.0.6 on one Apple Silicon Mac (macOS 27.2): capture, annotation, OCR, QR, pinning, selection translation and screenshot translation were used by hand; timings and memory above were measured there with a 60-entry history containing ten 5K screenshots. The final app and DMG passed notarization, stapling and Gatekeeper checks; all embedded Mach-O files are arm64. System translation on macOS 15–25 (SwiftUI path), other Mac/macOS combinations, multi-display capture and a live Sparkle installation of Build 67 have not been claimed as tested.
